annotations.title: Check a trucking company or freight broker

description: Looks up a U.S. motor carrier or freight broker in FMCSA public records by USDOT number or MC number. Returns its operating authority, liability insurance and bond on file, suspension or revocation notices, and plain-English red flags, each citing the FMCSA dataset it came from. Use before booking or paying a carrier or broker. Not a rating or a vetting decision.
name: lookup_carrier
